en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5369 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, who narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), that he was asked about a male camel (bukhti) that became enraged, left the house, and killed a man. Then the brother of the man came and struck the camel with a sword, injuring it.
Imam (as) said: "The owner of the camel is liable for the blood money, and he is entitled to receive the price of his camel."
